body:
Audited shared UI composition and corrected menu placement, modal focus/close ownership, vertical ordering and gesture cancellation. Fixed stale local drops, retained conditional Focus versions, corrected native-dialog previews and narrow controls, and restored active navigation visibility after rotation.

The combined 598-test gate, 35 existing/audit Chromium suites, eleven selected WebKit suites and HTTPS/planning workflows pass. The existing HTTPS app was rebuilt/restarted; all 42 assets match and 30 resource versions, two pins, both profiles' settings and the certificate are preserved. Evidence: progress/2026-10-04-ui-component-audit.md. Concurrent Main feature and owner card edits remain separate; physical-device and full release acceptance remain open.

metadata.summary: UI components and interaction consistency audited and unified
